impact: Incorrect final salary, leave liability, tax, payment or finance posting
pilot_disposition: Exclude FnF, encashment and settlement payments
required_evidence: Approved component/rounding/tax policy; same-record browser/API/PostgreSQL/payment/finance reconciliation

impact: Broken service, leave, tax, payroll, fiscal and organization continuity
required_evidence: Approved continuity policy and transactional multi-module certification

impact: Duplicate identity or incorrect service and benefit continuity
required_evidence: Approved identity/service/benefit rules and multi-spell browser/database evidence

impact: Unsafe or unscanned confidential uploads and unproven recovery
pilot_disposition: Disable uploads unless protected staging storage and scanning are active
required_evidence: Malware/provider failure, signed URL, encryption and backup/restore evidence

impact: Incorrect joiner/leaver entitlement and rounding
pilot_disposition: Restrict to configured proven proration mode
required_evidence: Approved matrix with boundary and rounding reconciliation

impact: Expired entitlement could be recreated or lost
required_evidence: Approved restoration/forfeiture treatment and append-only ledger tests

impact: Closed attendance or payroll evidence could be misreported
required_evidence: Connected browser historical report and closed-payroll non-recalculation evidence

impact: Unauthorized or incorrectly rated payroll input
required_evidence: Approved eligibility/approval/rate policy and exact payroll oracle

impact: Duplicate or lost attendance events after crash
pilot_disposition: Use bounded synchronous CSV only; disable biometric ingestion
required_evidence: Durable source identity, checkpoint and worker crash/replay evidence

impact: Incorrect legal deductions, employer liabilities or filings
pilot_disposition: Shadow calculation only; no statutory filing or real payroll
required_evidence: Approved effective-dated jurisdiction tables and independent oracles

impact: Duplicate or incorrect historical adjustments and tax treatment
pilot_disposition: Disable automatic arrears and supplementary retro processing
required_evidence: Approved delta/reversal policy and immutable historical reconciliation

impact: Duplicate, missing or unreconciled employee payments
pilot_disposition: No real payment initiation; artifacts only
required_evidence: Payment-instruction ledger, sandbox callbacks, reissue and balance reconciliation

impact: Premature workflow completion
required_evidence: Approved quorum semantics and concurrent browser/PostgreSQL evidence

impact: Unauthorized delegated approvals
required_evidence: Time-bounded grant/revoke model, permissions, audit and revocation tests

impact: Stalled or multiply assigned approvals
pilot_disposition: Disable automated escalation; use governed manual handling
required_evidence: Approved fallback/SLA policy and Celery idempotency evidence

impact: Unauthorized decision after manager transfer
pilot_disposition: Fail closed and require controlled manual disposition
required_evidence: Approved ownership rule and historical authority certification

impact: Current/future hierarchy ambiguity
pilot_disposition: Use effective employee movements; disable future master rename/reparent
required_evidence: Versioned master design and boundary-date browser/report evidence

impact: Incorrect historical headcount/cost allocation
required_evidence: Approved as-of/name semantics and independent historical totals

impact: Assignment may race archive/rename
pilot_disposition: Restrict archive while referenced and serialize administration
required_evidence: Explicit archive-versus-assignment contract and PostgreSQL race tests

impact: Inconsistent duplicate and partial acceptance behavior
required_evidence: Per-module idempotency/rollback matrix and browser/database evidence

impact: Truncated, misordered or unaudited exports
pilot_disposition: Limit pilot to certified report families and volumes
required_evidence: Row/filter/order/audit evidence for each enabled report

impact: Misleading stale success or download
required_evidence: Cancellation/race/retry evidence across every enabled family

impact: Duplicate or lost rows after process failure
required_evidence: Durable job/checkpoint model and crash/replay tests

impact: Revoked user may retain access grant
pilot_disposition: Use short-lived protected access and disable generated-letter sharing
required_evidence: Immediate revocation race evidence at API and object storage

impact: Data loss or unpredictable enforcement after downgrade
required_evidence: Connected over-limit downgrade lifecycle and audit evidence

impact: Duplicate tenant roles or seeds after external failure
required_evidence: External failure/resume and duplicate prevention evidence

impact: Continued privileged access after expiry or revocation
required_evidence: Active-session expiry/revocation browser/API audit and denial evidence

impact: Unlawful deletion or retention and incomplete backup disposition
required_evidence: Approved jurisdiction policy, legal hold, maker/checker, backup and erasure verification

impact: Incorrect historical leave, payroll or employment attribution
pilot_disposition: Synthetic/new tenants only; no legacy migration
required_evidence: Approved deterministic classification or permanent exception handling

impact: Potential overlap in unguarded configuration classes
required_evidence: Measured overlap preflight and constraints for demonstrated keys

impact: Query and lock degradation at multi-year volume
required_evidence: Staging EXPLAIN/pg_stat_statements at projected volume

impact: Unbounded storage growth and unproven restore
required_evidence: Archival, legal-hold and restore rehearsal

impact: Cookie, CSRF, host and transport security unverified on deployed domain
required_evidence: TLS/HSTS/secure-cookie/CSRF/trusted-host/proxy evidence

impact: Migration or data loss without tested recovery
required_evidence: Backup/restore and migration rollback rehearsal

impact: Lost or duplicated durable jobs
required_evidence: Managed Redis durability, monitoring, stale-worker and retry recovery

impact: Sensitive documents or payslips exposed/lost
required_evidence: Private buckets, encryption, signed expiry, malware scan and backup evidence

impact: False delivery/payment state
required_evidence: Externally supplied secrets and sandbox callback/reconciliation evidence

impact: Undetected failures or audit gaps
required_evidence: Logs, metrics, alerts, audit retention and incident ownership

impact: Downtime or incompatible schema rollout
required_evidence: Rolling deployment and controlled-downtime migration rehearsal

impact: Latency exceeds target above verified load
pilot_disposition: Cap pilot below 25 concurrent local-equivalent users
required_evidence: Isolated staging 25/50 VU benchmark; fixed 1500 ms p95 target
